GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2023-11-08T10:02:42Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: distributed engine inserts exceed memory, even if there is no limit set
Description: Creating new ticket as #50744 is closed and issue is not resolved.

Background inserts into distributed tables started throwing exception:
 DB::Exception: Memory limit (for query) exceeded: would use 9.31 GiB (attempt to allocate chunk of 4360448 bytes), maximum: 9.31 GiB

Even if i run SYSTEM FLUSH DISTRIBUTED ON CLUSTER cluster default.table, i get the same error.

Inserts on local node work ok. It also works ok with insert_distributed_sync=1. But as i would prefer to use async, i would like to go back to background inserts.

Memory limits are the same on all nodes:
```
┌─name─────────────────────────────┬─default─┬─value─┐
│ max_memory_usage                 │ 0       │ 0     │
│ max_memory_usage_for_user        │ 0       │ 0     │
│ max_memory_usage_for_all_queries │ 0       │ 0     │
└──────────────────────────────────┴─────────┴───────┘
```

system.distribution_queue has 2 entries(1 for each node it is trying to insert to). 
data_compressed_bytes: 9692170902

Each shard has a queue of around 13k files, ~10G in size. Even if i leave just 1 file in the queue, it still throws memory exceeded.
If i remove the first file, i get file not found exception.

How do i tell clickhouse to not use 10G memory limit?
